_tiers: settings.gd graphics_default: the graphics preset a machine starts on until the player picks one in Settings. Read top to bottom, the first rule that fits wins. discrete: a graphics card of its own (NVIDIA, AMD); name_has: any of these words in the graphics chip name Godot reports (Apple M3 Max, Apple M2 Pro); min_ram_gb: at least this much memory. finest = Beautiful drawn at still quality; beautiful = every pass; smooth = the costly passes off.
